This small plot is only 0.16 hectares, and since it is not my main maize field, I plant it with other crops mixed together — some groundnuts and beans with a bit of pumpkin. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer for this plot because the little I buy I put on my maize plot first. I will use the manure from my goats and chickens here, and keep the seed I saved from last harvest. My children and I will do the weeding ourselves; I have no money to hire people for this small piece of land.
